description: This file defines the `ActivationId` struct which uniquely identifies a grain activation in the Orleans distributed framework. It includes methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and deserialization of activation identifiers, as well as JSON conversion support.

classes.name: ActivationId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a grain activation, providing methods for creation, comparison, string formatting, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter class for serializing and deserializing ActivationId instances to and from JSON strings.

methods.name: ActivationId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ActivationId with a specific Guid.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates if the ActivationId is the default/zero value.

methods.name: GetDeterministic
methods.description: Creates a deterministic ActivationId based on a given GrainId.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the ActivationId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ActivationId.

methods.name: ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a parseable string representation suitable for reconstruction.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a string to create an ActivationId.
